rules.title: strncpy bounded by the source length
rules.why: strncpy(dst, src, strlen(src)) copies without room for the terminator and ignores the destination size.
rules.fix: Bound by sizeof(dst) - 1 and terminate explicitly.

rules.title: alloca with a variable size
rules.why: alloca with an attacker-influenced size can overflow the stack.
rules.fix: Use heap allocation with a checked upper bound.
